reply_text:
I replied to Ilse in the #north-team thread to confirm their note: they're on the road tomorrow morning (Thu 15 Oct) and reachable on mobile.

I checked the calendar for tomorrow and it's empty, so nothing needs moving. My reply worded this badly: it says "on my calendar," but the calendar I checked was most likely Ilse's. I also offered to add an "on the road" block to their calendar, or to pass anything urgent from the channel on to them.
